title: Add semantic table projections for progression/feature-owned tables
description: Deficiency #6 + thaw scope #5. 108 table records are source-complete but rows are generic scalar cells (e.g. 'The Barbarian' table label 'Path feature' is not applicable by a level-up engine). Add typed projections where needed: class progression tables -> class advancement rows; subclass spell tables -> auto-prepared/expanded spell grants; language tables -> selectable language pools; services/lodging/trade-goods -> purchasable/service or typed price rows; object AC/HP -> object damage adjudication metadata; destroy-undead/wild-shape/draconic-ancestry -> feature-owned typed option/progression tables. A table record alone is not a playable model.
design: LIKELY TOO LARGE for one session — split into child beads once the first agent scopes it against the code. Expected slices: (a) class progression tables -> advancement rows; (b) feature-owned progression tables (destroy-undead, wild-shape, draconic-ancestry); (c) price/service/lodging/trade-goods tables; (d) language + equipment selection tables; (e) spell/subclass spell tables; (f) object AC/HP -> damage-adjudication metadata. Promote .7 to a sub-epic if more than ~2 slices are non-trivial.
